svg.title: Picture generated by PcbDraw
svg.text: Kaidi desk dongle, protoboard build on an EPLZON 1.5 x 2 in board
A14 Bipom 2, with the desk cable's 2
I17 Bipom 3, with the desk cable's 3
C12 Bipom 7 through a 1k in the terminal
I9 Bipom 8, with the desk cable's 8
I16 Bipom 10 through a 1k in the terminal
H2 to G17 GND, insulated wire
K = keypad side, the Bipom breakout terminals.
D = the cut desk cable. Its 2, 3 and 8 share
Bipom terminals 2, 3 and 8 with the keypad.
Each row is two strips on the back: A-E and F-J.
Firmware: TX GPIO7, enables GPIO6 and GPIO0,
